meta.title: KasseiGo: shared bike & e-scooter app for Brussels and Paris
meta.description: Free app for shared bikes and e-scooters in Brussels and Paris: routes around cobblestones and no-ride zones, straight to a parking spot. No account, no ads.
meta.og_description: Free app for shared bikes and e-scooters in Brussels and Paris: around cobblestones and no-ride zones, to a real parking spot.
meta.og_image_alt: KasseiGo app: ride smooth, park right. Free, no account, no ads.
meta.app_description: Route-planning app for shared bikes and e-scooters in Brussels and Paris: avoids cobblestones, follows operator slow and no-ride zones, and guides you to a parking spot.

hero.title: Ride smooth.
hero.lead: The guide for shared bikes and e-scooters in Brussels and Paris (Dott, Bolt, Voi, Villo!, Vélib’). KasseiGo takes you around cobblestones and no-ride zones, and ends your trip at a real parking spot.
hero.shot_home_alt: Home screen: shared vehicles around you on the map, and a “Where to?” search.
hero.shot_preview_alt: Trip preview: 12 min to Place Eugène Flagey, with the departure and the parking spot already chosen.

why.title: Built for the vehicle under your feet.
why.intro: Regular map apps know cars and bikes. They don’t know cobblestones, operator zones, or where you’re allowed to leave a scooter.
why.surface_title: You decide how much it shakes
why.surface_text: Every street is rated by its surface. Set the roughest one you accept, and each trip shows how many metres of cobbles are left. Kassei is Brussels for cobblestone.
why.zones_text: Your operator’s slow and no-ride zones are part of the route. Choose to go around them or cross on foot, and see exactly where it happens.
why.parking_text: Pick your drop-off spot before you leave, with its free places when the operator publishes them. Guidance takes you straight there.
why.nearest_title: Park in one tap, wherever you are
why.nearest_text: Riding and want to stop now? Nearest parking finds your operator’s closest spot and guides you there. Changed your mind? Undo, and guidance goes back to your destination.

mock.surface_desc: The least comfortable surface you accept.
mock.no_ride_desc: Zones where the operator forbids riding: get off and push, or go around.

demo._comment: Words of the app for the interactive demos; {n}, {km}, {m}, {s}, {p}, {op} are filled in by the page.

facts.free_text: No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.
facts.switch_text: Battery low? Change operator from Trip options; zones, parking and route follow.

privacy.title: Your trips are nobody’s business.
privacy.text: Your location, trips, favourites and zones stay on your phone. Address search runs on the phone too. The network is only used for live vehicles, city packs and map tiles.

feedback.title: Your feedback shapes the app.
feedback.text: KasseiGo is in beta and made by one person in Brussels. A street that is wrong, a parking spot that no longer exists, an idea: every message is read and helps decide what comes next.
feedback.note: No account needed, a minute is enough.
feedback.bug_text: A wrong route, a screen that freezes, a crash.
feedback.data_text: A missing street, cobbles not shown, a parking spot that is gone.
feedback.idea_text: A city, an operator, a feature you miss.

get.title: Your next ride, without the bumps.
get.text: Free, in English, French and Dutch. In beta on iPhone, Android is on the way.

footer.independent: independent, not affiliated with any operator.
